spectators.label: Rice farmer with hoe
spectators.look: weathered rice farmer with a wide conical straw hat and a white towel around his neck; faded indigo work jacket, rolled-up gray pants, black rubber boots, a wooden hoe over his shoulder
spectators.shocked: straw hat blown back on its cord

spectators.label: Farm wife with radish basket
spectators.look: sturdy farm woman with a red polka-dot headscarf and rosy cheeks; green work blouse, a white apron, brown skirt, a woven basket of long white radishes on her arm
spectators.idle: basket on her arm, nodding along
spectators.cheer: waving a giant white radish in the air

spectators.label: Village elder with clay pipe
spectators.look: bent old villager with a wispy white goatee and small round spectacles; faded green quilted farmer's jacket, brown baggy pants, straw sandals, a small clay pipe and a knotty wooden cane
spectators.idle: puffing the clay pipe, leaning on the cane

spectators.label: Farm boy with chicken
spectators.look: freckled farm boy with tufty red hair and a gap-toothed grin; blue denim overalls over a white tee, bare feet, hugging a plump white chicken
spectators.cheer: holding the flapping chicken up high
spectators.shocked: chicken bursting out of his arms in a flurry of feathers

spectators.label: Burly dairy farmer
spectators.look: burly dairy farmer with a bushy brown beard and a straw cowboy hat; red-and-black plaid shirt under green overalls, muddy boots, a wooden pitchfork
spectators.cheer: arms spread wide to the sides, pitchfork in one hand, bellowing

spectators.label: Village girl with flower crown
spectators.look: sweet village girl with long auburn braids and a crown of white and yellow wildflowers; simple green dress with a white apron, brown shoes, a bouquet of wildflowers
spectators.shocked: bouquet dropped, hands over her mouth

spectators.label: Fisherman with catch
spectators.look: sun-tanned coastal fisherman with a twisted white headband and a scruffy black beard; bright yellow rain slicker, navy rubber boots, a bamboo fishing rod over his shoulder with a silver fish dangling from the line
spectators.idle: rod on his shoulder, fish swinging
spectators.shocked: fish flopping out of his grip

spectators.label: Woodcutter with axe
spectators.look: rugged woodcutter with a short black beard and a green knit cap; red-and-black buffalo-check flannel shirt with rolled sleeves, brown suspenders, tan work pants, a wood axe resting on his shoulder
spectators.idle: axe on his shoulder, calm stare
spectators.cheer: arms spread to the sides, axe held out, whooping
spectators.shocked: knit cap popping off, eyes wide

spectators.label: Granny with rice balls
spectators.look: tiny kindly granny with a gray hair bun; plain brown kimono with a dark green sash, white socks and straw sandals, a cloth-wrapped bundle and a white rice ball wrapped in seaweed
spectators.cheer: holding the rice ball up like a trophy
spectators.shocked: rice ball dropping, hands to her cheeks

spectators.label: Watermelon farmer
spectators.look: cheerful tanned farmer with cropped black hair and a white headband; white sleeveless undershirt, baggy brown work pants, rubber sandals, hugging a big green striped watermelon
spectators.shocked: watermelon slipping out of his arms

spectators.label: Village blacksmith
spectators.look: muscular village blacksmith with a soot-smudged face, singed short gray hair and thick forearms; brown leather apron over a sleeveless gray shirt, thick work gloves, a heavy iron hammer
spectators.cheer: hammer thrust out to the side, roaring
spectators.shocked: eyebrows singed straight up, hammer dropping

spectators.label: Toddler with tin bucket
spectators.look: chubby village toddler with a tuft of black hair and round red cheeks; red overall shorts over a white shirt, little straw sandals, a small tin bucket
spectators.shocked: bucket on his head, peeking out

spectators.label: Beekeeper with honey jar
spectators.look: beekeeper woman in a wide white hat with a mesh veil pushed back, revealing a braid of golden hair; baggy white beekeeping suit, yellow gloves, a glass jar of golden honey
spectators.idle: holding the honey jar up to the light
spectators.shocked: veil dropping over her face, honey jar wobbling
